title: Gate 2 G2-f: per-API-class A/B parity declarations
note: One entry per API class. A class names the fixtures whose parity the emulator's five rails already capture, and the suite file each fixture lives in, so conformance/narrow_class.py can hold the declaration to the suites' own bytes. The covered rules are the axes this declaration claims parity over; they are not the whole reims narrow class, and every widening of that class owes its own covered fixture here.

classes.name: compute-buffer-narrow
classes.summary: reims Gate 2's compute-buffer narrow class (research/docs/26 §2): one direct exact-thread dispatch over storage buffers, no images and no samplers.
classes.seam: the reims production seam's class gate (crates/reims-vgpu/src/backend/provider_compute.rs::narrow_class, submit_narrow) and its canonical entry test (crates/reims-vgpu/tests/canonical_provider_compute.rs) submit this same AIR file, examples/metal-smoke/shaders/kernel_copy_word.ll; the class gate itself is reviewed in the reims repository, this declaration only pins the fixture's bytes here
classes.bytes: every writeback and every post-pass allocation image, byte for byte, keyed by (allocation, view, offset)
classes.counts: each rail's own copy-in/copy-out contract is checked against the suite by compare.py; the counters are not compared rail to rail, because the rails observe them through different mechanisms (compare.py ALLOCATION_OBSERVATIONS)

refusals.why: a serial chain is several dispatches, not the class's one direct dispatch
the class binds storage buffers and no images or samplers

classes.name: render-narrow
classes.summary: the render narrow class's first reviewed shape (research/docs/26 §10, R3): one offscreen colour attachment, Clear load, one indexed draw, the whole attachment read back.
classes.seam: the reims render seam (crates/reims-vgpu/src/backend/provider_render.rs) and its reviewed shape test (crates/reims-vgpu/tests/provider_render_rail.rs) carry the same [declaring compute pass, one colour pass] trace shape; the class's later widenings (W1 chain heads, R6 vertex streams and scissor, W3 wide texels) are not covered by this declaration and owe their own fixtures
classes.bytes: every writeback and every post-pass allocation image, byte for byte, keyed by (allocation, view, offset)
classes.counts: each rail's own copy-in/copy-out contract is checked against the suite by compare.py; the counters are not compared rail to rail, because the rails observe them through different mechanisms (compare.py ALLOCATION_OBSERVATIONS)

refusals.why: the class's one draw is indexed; the vertex-id triangle carries no index buffer
a second colour attachment is MRT, not the single-attachment class
the first reviewed shape admits only a Clear load
the covered formats are the reviewed 8-bit colour formats; a wide texel is its own widening
